title: Tapered column from a sketch 30 up, Join with Extent All downwards, widening 10 degrees

expect.note: All for a join ends where the part ends that way (z = 0, like PartDesign's up to last). The column widens 10 degrees going down; inside the box it adds nothing (at z = 0 it is 20.58 square, still inside the 40 x 30 box), so the result equals extrude_taper_to_face: 12000 + the 20-tall frustum 10 -> 17.0531 = 3742.2554. Faces 11 as there. PartDesign's Pad ignores the taper for up to last, so SciForge builds it.
